heading: Classify Your Product
subheading: Answer a few questions and SAATHI will match your product to the applicable Indian Standard.
disclaimer: This is an illustrative classification against a small seeded catalogue, not a live BIS determination — verify directly with BIS or the Standards Browser before relying on it.
